ask: this is a mess fix it
sentence: Lets a group sign up for one of three fixed shower time windows with four spots each, reorder within a window, mark a long shower, and leave a short note.
use_when: A group shares limited hot water and needs to agree who showers when
Everyone should pick one slot and be able to move up or down in the order
People want to flag a long shower or add a short note about timing
You want to see who still has no slot
dont_use_when: The group needs a free-form calendar with custom times or dates
The task is a chore rota or a recurring schedule that repeats
The group needs a vote or poll on a choice rather than a turn order
